svg.title: Game room, gameplay service and matchmaking
svg.desc: game/ + application/gameplay_service. GameRoom is the single source of truth for one game (one mutex per room, Fischer clock, draw / rematch offers, reconnect grace). GameplayService runs every gameplay route; Matchmaker pairs quick-play players by rating.
svg.text: Game room, gameplay service and matchmaking
game/ + application/gameplay_service. GameRoom is the single source of truth for one game (one mutex per room, Fischer clock,
draw / rematch offers, reconnect grace). GameplayService runs every gameplay route; Matchmaker pairs quick-play players by rating.
